what_this_is: A Noir/UltraHonk verifier for the ZK predicate circuit, live on Base Sepolia. It accepts the same proof `bb verify` accepts offline, and refuses altered public inputs.
what_is_not_published: the measurement (87) and the salt — neither appears in the proof or the inputs
trusted_setup: None that this project owns. UltraHonk uses the universal Aztec Ignition SRS, so there is no circuit-specific ceremony and no trapdoor held here.
caveat: The generated verifier required annotating its five assembly blocks as memory-safe to compile (scripts/annotate-verifier-assembly.mjs). Those five blocks have now been reviewed against Solidity's memory-safe rules and hold — see docs/VERIFIER-ASSEMBLY-AUDIT.md — but by ONE reader, and that review covers only memory safety, not the verifier's cryptographic correctness. Nothing else about this verifier has been audited either. Testnet only; do not rely on this for value.
verify_it_yourself: # or on chain, against the deployed verifier:

assembly_audit.conclusion: all five satisfy Solidity's documented memory-safe definition
assembly_audit.limits: one reader; memory safety only; pinned by digest so a regenerated verifier fails CI rather than inheriting the review
